scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.ts && bun run --filter @oryx/gateway test && bun run --filter @oryx/web test && bun run --filter @oryx/desktop test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @oryx/web typecheck && bun run --filter @oryx/desktop typecheck && bun run --filter @oryx/gateway typecheck
scripts.build:web: bun run routes:generate && bun run --filter @oryx/web build
scripts.dev:web: bun run routes:generate && bun run --filter @oryx/web dev
scripts.check: bun run routes:check && bun run api:check && bun run test && bun run typecheck
